feeds.title: Essex CAJI
feeds.description: The UK Administrative Justice Institute (UKAJI) was established in 2014 and funded for three years to kickstart the expansion of empirical research on administrative justice in the UK. During that phase we built a community of researchers, policy-makers and practitioners involved in research on this important area of the justice system. Get to know all about administrative law at UKAJI.

feeds.title: Jotwell » Administrative Law
feeds.description: Jotwell, the Journal of Things We Like (Lots), is intended to provide a space where legal scholars from various specializations can go to identify and celebrate the latest work of their colleagues. The goal is to help Jotwell's readers locate interesting developments both inside and outside of their particular areas of interest and to encourage positive reviews and discussion of legal scholarship. Get to know the latest updates and news about administrative law at Jotwell.

feeds.title: Comparative Administrative Law Blog
feeds.description: Yale Law School is unique among law schools, in that it produces leaders in all walks of life. Read about the latest updates on administrative law at Yale Law School.

feeds.title: Drug & Device Law Blog » Administrative Law
feeds.description: This blog contains the personal views about various topics that arise in the defense of pharmaceutical and medical device product liability litigation. Find the news and updates on administrative law at Drug & Device Law blog.

feeds.title: Administrative Law Matters
feeds.description: Paul Daly, curator of the Administrative Law Matters blog, is a sought-after legal voice on matters of public importance. His insights are valued by parliamentary committees, governmental agencies, and legal practitioners across public and private sectors.

feeds.title: LiveWell » Finance
feeds.description: We aim to publish about one post every two weeks, and circulate news about the events in the administrative law field. We publish posts from scholars, practitioners, judges, and others - anyone interested in the field with something to say!

feeds.title: Harper Grey » Administrative Law
feeds.description: Harper Grey contains easy-to-navigate case databases and indexed archives that are organized by jurisdiction and type of legal issue. It provides immediate access to detailed case summaries and insightful commentary on cases that have helped shape the current state of administrative law.
